messages:
sam (People Ops): Planning a small internal "Glow Kit" drop to recognize contributors to the infra migration. Target delivery during team retro week (dates below). Need assembly leads, CSV QA, and a quick budget check.
rita (Events): I can coordinate SF assembly on 2024-07-09 3-5pm. What are counts and contents?
sam (People Ops): Counts: SF 24, NY 18, Remote 34, EMEA 6. Contents: small desktop plantlet (paper pot), enamel token, seed-paper postcard with a 1-line prompt for managers, a tiny snack, and a "do not open until retro" sticker.
noah (Logistics): Recommend office-split builds. I'll handle NY and EMEA shipping from NY office; SF can do theirs in-person. Need final CSV by 7/05 EOD for customs and shipping labels.
zoe (Finance): Budget code 10-CULT-2026. If unit cost > $22 flag me. Vendor invoice for plantlets pending; otherwise approved.
ops-bot: Reminder set: Final recipient CSV due 2024-07-05T23:59:00Z
rita (Events): Volunteers for SF so far: rita, jules, keiko. Need two more volunteers for 3-5pm slot.
sam (People Ops): Managers will handwrite the one-line message; we'll supply a sample prompt sheet: "Thanks for owning X part of the migration 1". Also include a short guide for tone.
noah (Logistics): Shipping note: EMEA packages need CN22 forms for customs, and tracking for remote. Please include declared value under $45 to simplify. I'll need per-kit weight; can someone seal a sample?
samsam (People Ops): (typo) I can assemble a sealed sample tonight and post weight.
rita (Events): Sample sealed weight: 240g. Noah, use that for postage. I'll bring label printer + pens.
oah (Logistics): Ordering 40 bubble mailers for remotes and 8 small boxes for EMEA. Also will run dedupe + postal validation on CSV once posted. Who owns QA?
sam (People Ops): I'll own QA but please run automated dedupe and address normalization before I sign off.
zoe (Finance): Confirming estimated spend: ~$1,150 under 10-CULT-2026 assuming current vendor costs. Flagging if plantlet PO exceeds estimate.
rita (Events): Assembly checklist draft:
- Pull final CSV (cleaned)
- Print seed-paper postcard + manager prompt sheet
- Pack plantlet, token, snack, postcard, sticker
- Pen station for managers to sign cards (if onsite)
- Seal + label for shipments or "hand-deliver" for on-site drops
- Photograph 2 sample kits and upload to #culture-photos

noah (Logistics): Courier pickup for NY remotes & EMEA scheduled 2024-07-10 09:00. SF handouts during retros on 7/11.
rita (Events): I'll make a volunteer sign-up and post in #culture-ambassadors. Two SF spots open.
ops-bot: Event reminder: Assembly SF lounge reserved 2024-07-09 15:00-17:00
sam (People Ops): Thanks all. Final timeline: 7/05 CSV QA complete -> 7/09 SF assembly -> 7/10 remote/EMEA ship -> 7/11 retro drops. Will post packing sheet and cleaned CSV in the shared folder when ready. :sparkles:
